verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers web/Office integrations, browser automation (Edge), and mobile/iOS/Android connectors, but nowhere documents an official standalone desktop app with OS-level keyboard shortcuts or the ability to see/interact with the user's screen content outside a browser. Vision (copilot-docs-30) is limited to photo/image analysis, not live screen capture, and Browse with Copilot (copilot-docs-9, -15, -24) is scoped to actions inside Microsoft Edge, not OS-wide screen access.
